question: In a club of 9 members, a sub-committee of 4 members is to be formed. How many different sub-committe
solution:
**Given:**

Total members = 9

Members to be selected = 4

**Formula used:**

Combination = ⁿCᵣ

nCr = n! ÷ [r! × (n − r)!]

**Calculation:**

Number of sub-committees = 9C4

⇒ 9C4 = 9! ÷ (4! × 5!)

⇒ (9 × 8 × 7 × 6 × 5!) ÷ (4 × 3 × 2 × 1 × 5!)

⇒ (9 × 8 × 7 × 6) ÷ (4 × 3 × 2 × 1)

⇒ 3024 ÷ 24

⇒ 126

**∴ Number of different sub-committees = 126.**
